candidates.violated_requirement: When the first bit of a group is 0 (matching the sequence start), the state machine incorrectly transitions to the failure path sf2 instead of the success path s2. This causes the module to incorrectly classify the sequence 011100 as not matching.
candidates.spec_basis: The module must detect the sequence 011100 from the input signal data. The sequence check begins with every sixth bit of input data.
